update-9-0-0-replace-set-parser-options-.description: Replaces the removed `setParserOptionsProject` application generator option with `enableTypedLinting` in generator defaults

update-9-0-1-add-webpack-library-type.description: Sets `output.library` to `commonjs2` in Forge app Webpack configs so the bundled functions export their handlers

update-10-0-0-bundle-dependencies.description: Makes the build of each Forge app inline all dependencies and write to the `bundle` folder of the artifact directory instead of `src`

update-10-0-0-add-manifest-packaging-key.description: Adds the `app.package` keys for manual packaging to the manifest of each Forge app

update-10-0-0-remove-package-ts-config.description: Removes the dropped `tsConfig` option from Forge app package targets
